criterionOutcomes.criterion: Open GIS from the V4 launcher; the GIS workspace loads with the map and its controls visible.
criterionOutcomes.reason: Direct screenshot evidence from attempt-003 shows the launcher and the loaded GIS workspace with map controls visible.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Open the map layer control and enable an available coverage or network layer; the selected layer becomes visible on the map.
criterionOutcomes.reason: Direct before/after screenshots from attempt-003 show the RPO Task and Actions layer enabled and visible with its legend.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Use the zoom-in control; the map visibly changes scale while remaining centred on the current area.
criterionOutcomes.reason: Direct before/after screenshots from attempt-003 show the map scale changing while the GIS workspace and control remain available.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Use the reset map view control; the map returns to its default view and the GIS controls remain usable.
criterionOutcomes.reason: Direct before/after screenshots from attempt-003 show reset-map interaction and retained GIS controls.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: Open the map style control and select another available style; the map appearance changes and the style control remains available for further use.
criterionOutcomes.reason: Direct screenshots from attempt-003 show the style options and the changed Dark map appearance.

reason: All five criteria were independently reviewed using non-empty PNG screenshots from the selected attempt-003 folder.
